title: Forkbook system map
intro: Forkbook (`@aussieljk/forkbook`) is a small, fast fork of Storybook for React with Vite, Next.js with Vite and React Native, shipped as one npm package whose areas are folders in `code/core/src`. Its main parts are the `forkbook` CLI, a local dev server (polka plus Vite or next dev) that serves the story index and a WebSocket channel, the manager UI and preview iframe in the browser, a Metro plug-in with a channel server for React Native devices, and MCP and tools APIs for coding agents. Everything runs on the developer's machine; only the npm release (GitHub Actions) and the docs site (Vercel at forkbook.ljk.dev) run elsewhere. Paths are relative to code/core/src unless they start at the repo root.
